Why Single-Image Color Grading Is 100% Mathematically Valid

You are spot on: a video frame sequence at 30 fps is mathematically a stream of spatial color tensors. A 3D LUT (Look-Up Table) operates in $O(1)$ constant time per pixel via tetrahedral interpolation. Because the LUT mapping matrix does not rely on motion vectors or historical frames, the spatial color transformation of a single video frame is bit-for-bit identical to applying it on the video stream.

What Video Adds: The Temporal Emulsion Physics

Where stills diverge from video in cinema is time ($t$). In real analog celluloid, silver halide crystal grains do not freeze—they dance randomly across consecutive frames (modeled via FFmpeg's temporal noise allf=t). Projector gate weave jitter (sin(14.5*t)) and organic exposure breath (sin(8.8*t)) only activate across motion, transforming a static grade into living film.

The 12 Canonical Cinematic Look Profiles

Every look is actively resolvable via user prompt, design metadata, or automatic aesthetic fallback in mini_run_pipeline.

Hollywood Complementary Color Contrast

Teal and Orange Blockbuster

★ Film Reference: Transformers, Mad Max: Fury Road, Top Gun: Maverick

The dominant color scheme of modern blockbusters. Pushes cool teal/cyan deep into the shadows and background while pulling warm peach and orange highlights on the human face for maximum subject isolation.

Pipeline Stack:
3D LUT Tetrahedral + Complementary Split-Toning + Punchy Midtone Contrast
lut3d=file='mini_run_pipeline/luts/teal_and_orange_blockbuster.cube':interp=tetrahedral,curves=all='0/0 0.5/0.5 0.75/0.75 0.88/0.85 0.96/0.92 1.0/0.965',colorbalance=rs=-0.08:gs=0.02:bs=0.06:rh=0.04:gh=0.01:bh=-0.04,eq=saturation=1.10,noise=alls=10:allf=t,vignette=eval=frame:angle=PI/(2+3*0.2):aspect=540/960:dither=1
Best: talking head, interview, narrative, commercial Avoid: flat, documentary, natural
Crushed Pedestal & Low-Key Atmospheric Tension

Moody/Dramatic Cinema

★ Film Reference: The Batman, Chernobyl, Sicario, Blade Runner 2049

Deep, oppressive shadows and desaturated midtones. Crushes dark regions to build dramatic weight while keeping key facial highlights cleanly legible.

Pipeline Stack:
3D LUT Tetrahedral + Low-Key Shadow Crush + Gamma Compression (0.90)
lut3d=file='mini_run_pipeline/luts/moody_dramatic_cinema.cube':interp=tetrahedral,curves=all='0/0 0.5/0.5 0.75/0.75 0.88/0.85 0.96/0.92 1.0/0.965',colorbalance=rs=-0.08:gs=0.02:bs=0.06:rh=0.04:gh=0.01:bh=-0.04,eq=saturation=1.10,noise=alls=10:allf=t,vignette=eval=frame:angle=PI/(2+3*0.2):aspect=540/960:dither=1

1970s Warm Tungsten Nostalgia & Analog Texture

Vintage Film Emulation

★ Film Reference: Licorice Pizza, Once Upon a Time in Hollywood, Mid90s

Warm, sun-faded aesthetic evoking vintage 16mm/35mm Kodak Tri-X and Ektachrome stocks. Midtones are warmed with a golden-yellow bias and blacks are lifted slightly.

Pipeline Stack:
3D LUT Tetrahedral + 4500K Warm Cast + Black Point Lift + Temporal Grain
lut3d=file='mini_run_pipeline/luts/vintage_film_emulation.cube':interp=tetrahedral,curves=all='0/0 0.5/0.5 0.75/0.75 0.88/0.85 0.96/0.92 1.0/0.965',colorbalance=rs=-0.08:gs=0.02:bs=0.06:rh=0.04:gh=0.01:bh=-0.04,eq=saturation=1.10,noise=alls=8:allf=t,vignette=eval=frame:angle=PI/(2+3*0.25):aspect=540/960:dither=1

Electric Magenta, Neon Cyan & High-Saturation Night

Neon Tokyo / Cyberpunk

★ Film Reference: John Wick 4, Drive, Blade Runner 2049, Enter the Void

Hyper-stylized night palette. Channels vibrant purples, magentas, and electric cyans across reflections and ambient lighting. Perfect for creative, tech, and nightlife content.

Pipeline Stack:
Color Channel Mixer + Hue Saturation Gain (1.4x) + Blue/Magenta Curve Lift
colortemperature=5500,colorchannelmixer=rr=1:rg=0:rb=0:gr=0:gg=0.8:gb=0.2:br=0:bg=0.1:bb=1,huesaturation=hue=0.05:saturation=0.55,curves=red='0/0 0.5/0.5 1/1',curves=green='0/0 0.5/0.45 1/0.9',curves=blue='0/0.05 0.5/0.55 1/1',eq=brightness=0:contrast=1.1:gamma=0.95:saturation=1.3,curves=all='0/0 0.5/0.5 0.75/0.75 0.88/0.85 0.96/0.92 1.0/0.965',colorbalance=rs=-0.08:gs=0.02:bs=0.06:rh=0.04:gh=0.01:bh=-0.04,eq=saturation=1.10,noise=alls=10:allf=t,vignette=eval=frame:angle=PI/(2+3*0.2):aspect=540/960:dither=1
Best: tech, gaming, creative, night footage Avoid: interview, talking head, corporate
Silver Retention, Harsh Contrast & Muted Saturation

Bleach Bypass

★ Film Reference: Saving Private Ryan, Fight Club, Seven, Minority Report

Emulates the photochemical process where the bleaching step is skipped, retaining silver grains alongside the color dyes. Delivers piercing specular highlights and muted, desaturated tones.

Pipeline Stack:
3D LUT Tetrahedral + Silver Retention Contrast (1.35x) + 40% Desaturation
lut3d=file='mini_run_pipeline/luts/bleach_bypass.cube':interp=tetrahedral,curves=all='0/0 0.5/0.5 0.75/0.75 0.88/0.85 0.96/0.92 1.0/0.965',colorbalance=rs=-0.08:gs=0.02:bs=0.06:rh=0.04:gh=0.01:bh=-0.04,eq=saturation=1.10,noise=alls=10:allf=t,vignette=eval=frame:angle=PI/(2+3*0.2):aspect=540/960:dither=1

High-Latitude Monochrome & Lifted Matte Black

Faded Black & White

★ Film Reference: Roma, Mank, The Lighthouse, Cold War

Artistic high-latitude monochrome. Desaturates color completely, maps luminance with custom spectral weighting (33% R / 34% G / 33% B), lifts the black point, and adds silver emulsion grain.

Pipeline Stack:
Spectral Monochrome Channel Mixer + Lifted Black Pedestal + Emulsion Grain
colorchannelmixer=rr=0.33:rg=0.34:rb=0.33:gr=0.33:gg=0.34:gb=0.33:br=0.33:bg=0.34:bb=0.33,curves=red='0/0.05 0.5/0.45 1/0.95',curves=green='0/0.05 0.5/0.45 1/0.95',curves=blue='0/0.05 0.5/0.45 1/0.95',eq=brightness=0.02:contrast=0.85:gamma=1.1:saturation=0,curves=all='0/0 0.5/0.5 0.75/0.75 0.88/0.85 0.96/0.92 1.0/0.965',colorbalance=rs=-0.08:gs=0.02:bs=0.06:rh=0.04:gh=0.01:bh=-0.04,eq=saturation=1.10,noise=alls=6:allf=t,vignette=eval=frame:angle=PI/(2+3*0.2):aspect=540/960:dither=1
